title: Computational Insights into the Molecular Dynamics of the Binding of Ligands in the Methanol Dehydrogenase
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甲醇脱氢酶与配体的分子动力学结合，属于酶-小分子体系，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Methanol dehydrogenase (MDH) is a promising biocatalyst for industrial use, converting methanol to formaldehyde. Our molecular modeling revealed methanol binds to MDH with ∼7 kcal/mol free energy, while formaldehyde binds with ∼4 kcal/mol. This suggests methanol remains longer in the active site, and formaldehyde exits more readily post-reaction. These insights are crucial for designing more efficient MDH variants for industrial applications. Graphical abstract The left panel shows methanol and formaldehyde within the active site of methanol dehydrogenase, illustrating entry and release paths. The right panel presents the free energy profiles, indicating methanol’s stronger binding affinity and formaldehyde’s easier release post-reaction.
abstract_zh: 甲醇脱氢酶（MDH）是一种有前景的工业用生物催化剂，可将甲醇转化为甲醛。我们的分子建模揭示，甲醇与MDH结合的自由能约为7 kcal/mol，而甲醛结合的自由能约为4 kcal/mol。这表明甲醇在活性位点停留时间更长，而甲醛在反应后更容易释放。这些见解对于设计更高效的MDH变体以用于工业应用至关重要。图形摘要 左图展示了甲醇和甲醛在甲醇脱氢酶活性位点内的位置，说明了进入和释放路径。右图呈现了自由能谱，表明甲醇具有更强的结合亲和力，而甲醛在反应后更易释放。
